rules.statement: Spell every link to or reference of an NCodeGroup repository with its GitHub name, such as `https://github.com/NCodeGroup/identity` or `NCodeGroup/identity#760`, not with an invented or display name.
rules.why: A reference is only reliable when it uses the repository's actual GitHub name; GitHub resolves names case-insensitively, so capitalization alone is not a defect.
rules.check: Look for repository links or `owner/repo#number` references in docs, ADRs, AGENTS.md and PR text that use a name other than the real GitHub repository name; don't report capitalization differences alone.

rules.statement: Mark every npm workspace package in the product's frontend workspace `"private": true`, name it under the `@ncode/` scope, and never publish it.
rules.why: The frontend's packages are built into the console image and are not a published contract.
rules.check: Look for a new or changed `package.json` under the frontend workspace that lacks `"private": true`, uses a name outside `@ncode/*`, or adds publish configuration.

rules.statement: Name NuGet packages `NCode.Identity.*`, the host chart `ncode-identity-host`, and images under `ghcr.io/ncodegroup/ncode-identity-*`.
rules.why: A package ID or image name is permanent once published, so the naming scheme is fixed up front.
rules.check: Look for new package IDs, chart names or image names in project files, charts or workflows that don't follow the fixed scheme.
